description.content: Asset catalog read operations: list by category, detail view, import from Sketchfab, topographic symbols.
Second user registration, invitation acceptance, and member management.

Fully automated API test suite for UrbanLand backend. Covers Auth, Admin, Projects, Scenes, Assets, and Invitations with both happy-path and error-case tests.

## Running
### One-click (requires Node.js + Newman):
  .\run-tests.ps1

### Manual (in Postman):
  Import collection + environment. Set {{baseUrl}}. Run folder-by-folder or use Collection Runner.

## Test Data Flow
  1. Auth → registers urbantest.main, tests login/refresh/profile/password
  2. Admin → logs seed admin, promotes a user
  3. Projects → creates project, settings, invitation
  4. Scenes → imports asset, creates scene, places/moves/removes objects
  5. Assets → queries and verifies asset catalog
  6. Invitations → second user registers and accepts invite

## Variables
  {{accessToken}}      — main user JWT
  {{adminAccessToken}}  — admin JWT
  {{secondAccessToken}} — second user JWT
  {{projectId}} / {{sceneId}} / {{sceneObjectId}} — created during run
